description: Election Commission - Filling of a vacancy in the office of member of the Medawachchiya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Medawachchiya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by resignation, which falls under election-related administrative matters.
